purpose: Dedicated suggestions registry. Anyone reviewing the site can read each suggestion, its evidence, its cost/risk, and its status. A suggestion is NEVER implemented directly from this page: the reviewer (repo owner) selects the best path, and only then does an integration session implement it on its own branch with COORDINATION.md records.
workflow: 1. PROPOSED — logged here with evidence and a discovery path.
2. UNDER REVIEW — the reviewer is evaluating; decision questions it depends on are listed.
3. APPROVED — reviewer picked a path; implementation task is created on COORDINATION.md.
4. IMPLEMENTED — live on the site, with the implementing PR linked.
5. REJECTED/DEFERRED — recorded with the reason so the same idea is not re-litigated blindly.

rows.title: Ingest a trusted market-reference odds feed for CLV and edge measurement
rows.evidence: Originated lines currently compare to archived nflverse market lines (secondary, delayed). Live CLV (G7) is impossible without a price feed.
rows.impact: Enables validation gates G7 and real leaderboard tiers; biggest single unlock for the leaderboard's 'remove luck' goal.
rows.risk: Non-official source conflicts with the site's official-only row rule; needs an explicitly flagged secondary-source policy.

rows.title: Weekly automated refresh of injury/depth/EPA snapshots (Friday 21:05 UTC cron)
rows.evidence: nfl-refresh.yml workflow already committed; cron schedules the fetch+rebuild each Friday after final injury designations.
rows.impact: Removes all manual data input; keeps injury tracking current without human action.
rows.risk: Cron commits to main could interleave with open PR branches; mitigation: concurrency guard + rebase pull already in the workflow.

rows.title: Player-prop baseline tables (usage, snap share, per-game distributions)
rows.evidence: snap_counts_2026.csv.gz and play-by-play are already committed; prop baselines are computable today; only prop LINES are missing (Q1/Q7).
rows.impact: Prepares the prop-combo leaderboard lane demanded by the project brief.
rows.risk: Low — read-only computations; page size manageable.

rows.title: Inactive-list monitoring at the 90-minute window before kickoff
rows.evidence: Official inactives land ~90 minutes pre-kickoff (NFL.com publishes weekly inactives pages); designation changes between Friday report and inactive list are a known decision point.
rows.impact: Late-swap protection for any graded strategy; prevents grading on stale availability.
rows.risk: Requires a Sunday-morning fetch schedule and a trusted source for inactives (NFL.com news pages are official).

rows.title: Correlation-aware parlay builder in the UI
rows.evidence: nfl-correlation.html ships a Bernoulli-covariance calculator this session; a builder that assembles multi-leg tickets with joint probability and EV would make it usable, not just explainable.
rows.impact: Directly serves the parlay/player-prop requirement; makes correlation visible instead of an afterthought.
rows.risk: UI scope; needs discipline to avoid implying available prices (none ingested).

rows.title: Extend committed history to 1999-2025 seasons for signal calibration
rows.evidence: nflverse schedules/play-by-play releases cover 1999+; 2026-only samples are too small for G3/G4 (rest buckets n≈10, holdout n≈40).
rows.impact: Makes validation gates meaningful; estimated signal effects become calibratable.
rows.risk: ~9 more seasons of pbp (~80 MB compressed) in Git — exceeds comfortable repo weight; better as an on-demand fetch task than a default commit.

rows.title: Publish the strategy-registration JSON schema and an example submission
rows.evidence: strategies.json defines gates but submissions need a concrete schema to be reviewable.
rows.impact: Lets future sessions/agents submit strategies without ambiguity; keeps the registry append-only.

rows.title: Wednesday/Friday injury-designation change alerts (diff table)
rows.evidence: The official report sharpens Wednesday→Friday; the valuable signal is the CHANGE (e.g., upgrade to Full, downgrade to Out). A diff table between snapshots would expose it.
rows.impact: Turns the injury tracker from a snapshot into a true tracker; supports S4/S5 signals with better timing.
rows.risk: Needs two snapshots per week (storage fine; workflow cron change).

rows.title: Bankroll/stake policy page (flat vs fractional Kelly) once prices exist
rows.evidence: Grading is flat 1-unit today; Kelly sizing is meaningless without prices and would add variance to leaderboard comparisons.
rows.impact: Prevents sizing from being confused with picking skill on the leaderboard.

rows.title: Add a 'model performance vs market' week-by-week accuracy page
rows.evidence: The 2026 EPA model hits MAE ≈ 8-9 points on holdout weeks (signals-2026.json); a weekly accuracy table would make model drift visible.
rows.impact: Honest, ongoing self-evaluation; feeds G4 evidence over time.

review_note: Reviewer: repo owner. Default reviewer instruction recorded in open-questions.json. No suggestion above modifies shared dashboard data; all are scoped to the NFL analytics module unless the reviewer approves otherwise.
